verses.en: Hearken, O ye people of my church, saith the Lord your God, and hear the word of the Lord concerning you—
verses.sm: Faalogo mai ia, E outou e tagata o la’u ekalesia, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii lo outou Atua, ma faalogo mai i le afioga a le Alii e faatatau ia te outou—

verses.en: The Lord who shall suddenly come to his temple; the Lord who shall come down upon the world with a curse to judgment; yea, upon all the nations that forget God, and upon all the ungodly among you.
verses.sm: O le Alii o lē o le a faafuasei ona afio mai i lona malumalu; o le Alii o lē o le a afio ifo i le lalolagi ma se fetuu e faamasino; ioe, i luga o atunuu uma ua faagalo le Atua, ma i luga o tagata lē amioatua uma o i totonu o outou.

verses.en: For he shall make bare his holy arm in the eyes of all the nations, and all the ends of the earth shall see the salvation of their God.
verses.sm: Auā o le a faaali e ia lona aao paia i mata o atunuu uma, ma o le a vaai tuluiga uma o le lalolagi i le faaolataga a lo latou Atua.

w.en: in the eyes of all nations;
and all the ends of the earth shall see

verses.en: Wherefore, prepare ye, prepare ye, O my people; sanctify yourselves; gather ye together, O ye people of my church, upon the land of Zion, all you that have not been commanded to tarry.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, ia outou saunia, ia outou saunia, E lo’u nuu e; ia outou faapaia outou lava; ia outou faapotopoto faatasi, E outou e tagata o la’u ekalesia, i luga o le laueleele o Siona, outou uma ia e lei poloaiina e nonofo pea.

verses.en: Go ye out from Babylon. Be ye clean that bear the vessels of the Lord.
verses.sm: Ia outou o ese mai Papelonia. Ia mamā outou o e e tauaveina ipu a le Alii.

verses.en: Call your solemn assemblies, and speak often one to another. And let every man call upon the name of the Lord.
verses.sm: Talo a outou faapotopotoga mamalu, ma tautala pea lava pea le tasi i le isi. Ma ia tuu atu i tagata taitoatasi e valaau atu i le suafa o le Alii.

verses.en: Yea, verily I say unto you again, the time has come when the voice of the Lord is unto you: Go ye out of Babylon; gather ye out from among the nations, from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.
verses.sm: Ioe, e moni Ou te toe fai atu ia te outou, ua oo mai le taimi ua oo mai ai le siufofoga o le Alii ia te outou: Ia outou o ese mai Papelonia; ia outou faapotopoto i fafo mai atunuu, mai matagi e fa, mai le tasi tuluiga o le lagi i le isi.

verses.en: Send forth the elders of my church unto the nations which are afar off; unto the islands of the sea; send forth unto foreign lands; call upon all nations, first upon the Gentiles, and then upon the Jews.
verses.sm: Auina atu toeaina o la’u ekalesia i atunuu mamao; i motu o le sami; auina atu i laueleele ese; valaau atu i atunuu uma, muamua i Nuuese, ona sosoo lea ma tagata Iutaia.

verses.en: And behold, and lo, this shall be their cry, and the voice of the Lord unto all people: Go ye forth unto the land of Zion, that the borders of my people may be enlarged, and that her stakes may be strengthened, and that Zion may go forth unto the regions round about.
verses.sm: Ma faauta, ma taga’i, o la latou alaga atu lenei, ma le siufofoga o le Alii i tagata uma: Inā outou o atu ia i le laueleele o Siona, ina ia mafai ona faalauteleina tuaoi o lo’u nuu, ma ina ia faamalolosia ona siteki, ma ina ia mafai ona alu atu o Siona i nofoaga o faataamilo ai.

verses.en: Yea, let the cry go forth among all people: Awake and arise and go forth to meet the Bridegroom; behold and lo, the Bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet him. Prepare yourselves for the great day of the Lord.
verses.sm: Ioe, ia tuu atu le alaga ia alu atu i totonu o tagata uma: Ala mai ia ma tutulai mai ma o atu e faafetaia’i i le Faatoafaiavā; faauta ma taga’i, ua afio mai le Faatoafaiavā; ia outou o atu ia e faafetaia’i ia te ia. Ia saunia outou lava mo le aso tele o le Alii.

verses.en: Watch, therefore, for ye know neither the day nor the hour.
verses.sm: O lea, ia mataala, aua tou te lē iloa le aso po o le itula.

verses.en: Let them, therefore, who are among the Gentiles flee unto Zion.
verses.sm: O lea, ia tuu atu ia te i latou, o e o i totonu o Nuuese ia sosola i Siona.

verses.en: And let them who be of Judah flee unto Jerusalem, unto the mountains of the Lord's house.
verses.sm: Ma ia tuu atu ia te i latou o e o Iuta ia sosola i Ierusalema, i mauga o le maota o le Alii.

verses.en: Go ye out from among the nations, even from Babylon, from the midst of wickedness, which is spiritual Babylon.
verses.sm: Ia outou o ese mai totonu o atunuu, mai Papelonia lava, mai le lotolotoi o le amioleaga, o Papelonia faaleagaga lea.

verses.en: But verily, thus saith the Lord, let not your flight be in haste, but let all things be prepared before you; and he that goeth, let him not look back lest sudden destruction shall come upon him.
verses.sm: Ae e moni, ua faapea ona fetalai mai o le Alii, ia lē faanatinatia la outou solaaga, ae ia tuu atu ia mua’i saunia mea uma i o outou luma; ma o ia o lē e alu, ia lē tuu atu ia te ia e tepa i tua ne’i faafuase’i ona oo mai o le faafanoga i ona luga.

verses.en: Hearken and hear, O ye inhabitants of the earth. Listen, ye elders of my church together, and hear the voice of the Lord; for he calleth upon all men, and he commandeth all men everywhere to repent.
verses.sm: Uai mai ia ma faalogo mai, E outou e ua nonofo i le lalolagi. Faalogo mai faatasi, outou toeaina o la’u ekalesia, ma faafofoga i le siufofoga o le Alii; aua ua valaau atu o ia i tagata uma, ma ua poloaiina e ia tagata uma o i soo se mea ia salamo.

verses.en: For behold, the Lord God hath sent forth the angel crying through the midst of heaven, saying: Prepare ye the way of the Lord, and make his paths straight, for the hour of his coming is nigh—
verses.sm: Aua faauta, ua auina atu e le Alii le Atua le agelu ua alaga atu i le taulotoaiga o le lagi, ua fetalai atu; Ia outou saunia le ala o le Alii, ma faasa’osa’o ona ala, aua ua lata mai le itula o lona afio mai—

verses.en: When the Lamb shall stand upon Mount Zion, and with him a hundred and forty-four thousand, having his Father's name written on their foreheads.
verses.sm: Pe a tulai le Tamai Mamoe i luga o le Mauga o Siona, ma se selau ma le fasefulu-fa afe faatasi ma ia, ua tusia i o latou muaulu le suafa o lona Tamā.

verses.en: Wherefore, prepare ye for the coming of the Bridegroom; go ye, go ye out to meet him.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, ia outou saunia mo le afio mai o le Faatoafaiavā; ia outou o atu ia, ia outou o atu ia e faafetaia’i ia te ia.

verses.en: For behold, he shall stand upon the mount of Olivet, and upon the mighty ocean, even the great deep, and upon the islands of the sea, and upon the land of Zion.
verses.sm: Aua faauta, o le a tulai o ia i luga o le mauga o Olive, ma i luga o le vasa tele, le loloto tele lea, ma i luga o motu o le sami, ma i luga o le laueleele o Siona.

verses.en: And he shall utter his voice out of Zion, and he shall speak from Jerusalem, and his voice shall be heard among all people;
verses.sm: Ma o le a tulei atu e ia lona siufofoga i fafo mai Siona, ma o le a fetalai o ia mai Ierusalema, ma o le a faalogoina lona siufofoga i totonu o tagata uma;

verses.en: And it shall be a voice as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of a great thunder, which shall break down the mountains, and the valleys shall not be found.
verses.sm: Ma o le a avea o se siufofoga e pei o se leo o vai e tele, ma e pei o le leo o se faititili tele, o le a soloia ai i lalo mauga, ma o le a lē toe maua vanu.

verses.en: He shall command the great deep, and it shall be driven back into the north countries, and the islands shall become one land;
verses.sm: O le a poloaiina e ia le loloto tele, ma o le a toe tulia i tua i itu-laueleele i matu, ma o le a avea motu ma laueleele e tasi;

verses.en: And the land of Jerusalem and the land of Zion shall be turned back into their own place, and the earth shall be like as it was in the days before it was divided.
verses.sm: Ma o le laueleele o Ierusalema ma le laueleele o Siona o le a toe faafoi i tua i o laua lava nofoaga, ma o le a avea lava le lalolagi e pei ona sa i ai i aso a’o lei vaevaeina.

verses.en: And the Lord, even the Savior, shall stand in the midst of his people, and shall reign over all flesh.
verses.sm: Ma o le a tulai le Alii, le Faaola lava ia, i le lotolotoi o lona nuu, ma o le a nofotupu i luga o tagata uma.

verses.en: And they who are in the north countries shall come in remembrance before the Lord; and their prophets shall hear his voice, and shall no longer stay themselves; and they shall smite the rocks, and the ice shall flow down at their presence.
verses.sm: Ma o i latou o e o loo i itu-laueleele i matu o le a manatua i luma o le Alii; ma o le a faalogo o latou perofeta i lona siufofoga, ma o le a latou lē toe taofi i latou lava; ma o le a latou taia papa, ma o le a tafe ifo i lalo le aisa i o latou luma.

verses.en: And an highway shall be cast up in the midst of the great deep.
verses.sm: Ma o le a lafoia se alatele i le totonugalemu o le loloto tele.

verses.en: Their enemies shall become a prey unto them,
verses.sm: O o latou fili o le a avea o se vete ia te i latou,

verses.en: And in the barren deserts there shall come forth pools of living water; and the parched ground shall no longer be a thirsty land.
verses.sm: Ma i totonu o toafa naumati o le a sau ai lepa o vai ola; ma o eleele maveve o le a lē toe avea o se laueleele matutu.

verses.en: And they shall bring forth their rich treasures unto the children of Ephraim, my servants.
verses.sm: Ma o le a latou aumai a latou ’oa taua i fanau a Efaraima, o a’u auauna.

verses.en: And the boundaries of the everlasting hills shall tremble at their presence.
verses.sm: Ma o le a gatete tuaoi o mauga tumau e faavavau i o latou luma.

verses.en: And there shall they fall down and be crowned with glory, even in Zion, by the hands of the servants of the Lord, even the children of Ephraim.
verses.sm: Ma o iina o le a latou faapa’u’ū ai i lalo ma faapaleina i le mamalu, i Siona lava, e lima o auauna a le Alii, le fanau lava a Efaraima.

verses.en: And they shall be filled with songs of everlasting joy.
verses.sm: Ma o le a faatumuina i latou i pese o le olioli tumau e faavavau.

verses.en: Behold, this is the blessing of the everlasting God upon the tribes of Israel, and the richer blessing upon the head of Ephraim and his fellows.
verses.sm: Faauta, o le faamanuiaga lea a le Atua tumau e faavavau i luga o ituaiga o Isaraelu, ma le faamanuiaga ’oa tele atu i luga o le ulu o Efaraima ma ana aumea.

verses.en: And they also of the tribe of Judah, after their pain, shall be sanctified in holiness before the Lord, to dwell in his presence day and night, forever and ever.
verses.sm: Ma o i latou foi o le ituaiga o Iuta, pe a mavae lo latou tiga, o le a faapaiaina i le paia i luma o le Alii, e nonofo i ona luma i le ao ma le po, e faavavau ma faavavau lava.

verses.en: And now, verily saith the Lord, that these things might be known among you, O inhabitants of the earth, I have sent forth mine angel flying through the midst of heaven, having the everlasting gospel, who hath appeared unto some and hath committed it unto man, who shall appear unto many that dwell on the earth.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, e moni ua fetalai mai le Alii, ina ia mafai ona iloa ia mea i totonu o outou, E outou e ua nonofo i le lalolagi, na Ou auina atu ai la’u agelu e lele atu i le taulotoaiga o le lagi, ua i ai le talalelei tumau e faavavau, o lē na faaali atu i ni isi ma tuu atu lea talalelei i tagata, o lē o le a faaali atu i le toatele o e ua nonofo i le lalolagi.

verses.en: And this gospel shall be preached unto every nation, and kindred, and tongue, and people.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei talalelei o le a talai atu i atunuu uma, ma ituaiga, ma gagana, ma nuu.

verses.en: And the servants of God shall go forth, saying with a loud voice: Fear God and give glory to him, for the hour of his judgment is come;
verses.sm: Ma o le a o atu auauna a le Atua, ma fai atu ma le leo tele: Ia matata’u i le Atua ma avatu le viiga ia te ia, aua ua oo mai le itula o lana faamasinoga;

verses.en: And worship him that made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and the fountains of waters—
verses.sm: Ma ia tapuai atu ia te ia o lē na faia le lagi, ma le lalolagi, ma le sami, ma puna o vai—

verses.en: Calling upon the name of the Lord day and night, saying: O that thou wouldst rend the heavens, that thou wouldst come down, that the mountains might flow down at thy presence.
verses.sm: Ma valaau atu i le suafa o le Alii i le ao ma le po, fai atu: E, pe a na e saeia le lagi, ma e afio mai i lalo, ina ia solo mai i lalo mauga i ou luma.

verses.en: And it shall be answered upon their heads; for the presence of the Lord shall be as the melting fire that burneth, and as the fire which causeth the waters to boil.
verses.sm: Ma o le a tali i luga o o latou ulu; ona o luma o le Alii o le a pei o le afi faaliusuavai e mumū, ma e pei o le afi e faapupuna ai le vai.

verses.en: O Lord, thou shalt come down to make thy name known to thine adversaries, and all nations shall tremble at thy presence—
verses.sm: E, le Alii e, o le a e afio ifo e faailoa atu lou suafa i ou fili, ma o le a gatete atunuu uma i ou luma—

verses.en: When thou doest terrible things, things they look not for;
verses.sm: A e faia mea mata’utia, o mea latou te lei manatu i ai;

verses.en: Yea, when thou comest down, and the mountains flow down at thy presence, thou shalt meet him who rejoiceth and worketh righteousness, who remembereth thee in thy ways.
verses.sm: Ioe, a e afio mai i lalo, ma solo i lalo mauga i ou luma, o le a e faafetaia’i ia te ia o lē ua olioli ma faia le amiotonu, o lē ua manatuaina oe i ou ala.

verses.en: For since the beginning of the world have not men heard nor perceived by the ear, neither hath any eye seen, O God, besides thee, how great things thou hast prepared for him that waiteth for thee.
verses.sm: Aua talu mai le amataga o le lalolagi e lei faalogo lava tagata pe na lagona i le taliga, pe na vaaia foi e se mata, e ese mai ia te oe, E le Atua e, le silisili o mea ua e saunia mo ia o lē e faatalitali ia te oe.

verses.en: And it shall be said: Who is this that cometh down from God in heaven with dyed garments; yea, from the regions which are not known, clothed in his glorious apparel, traveling in the greatness of his strength?
verses.sm: Ma o le a fai ane: O ai lenei ua afio ifo mai le Atua o i le lagi ma la’ei mumu; ioe, mai mea e lei faaalia, ua ofu i ona laei mamalu, ua afio mai i le silisiliese o lona malosi?

verses.en: And he shall say: I am he who spake in righteousness, mighty to save.
verses.sm: Ma o le a fai mai o ia: O A’u o lē e tautala i le amiotonu, ua malosi e faaola.

verses.en: And the Lord shall be red in his apparel, and his garments like him that treadeth in the wine-vat.
verses.sm: Ma o le Alii o le a mūmū ona ofu, ma o ona la’ei o le a pei o ia o lē e solia le tanoa-vine.

verses.en: And so great shall be the glory of his presence that the sun shall hide his face in shame, and the moon shall withhold its light, and the stars shall be hurled from their places.
verses.sm: Ma o le a matua tele lava le mamalu i ona luma o le a natia ai e le la ona mata i le maasiasi, ma o le a taofi e le masina lona malamalama, ma o le a lia’i ese fetu mai i o latou nofoaga.

verses.en: And his voice shall be heard: I have trodden the wine-press alone, and have brought judgment upon all people; and none were with me;
verses.sm: Ma o le a faalogoina lona siufofoga: Ua Ou solia toatasi le soliga-vine, ma Ou aumai le faamasinoga i luga o lo’u nuu atoa; ma sa leai ni isi sa faatasi ma a’u;

verses.en: And I have trampled them in my fury, and I did tread upon them in mine anger, and their blood have I sprinkled upon my garments, and stained all my raiment; for this was the day of vengeance which was in my heart.
verses.sm: Ma sa Ou solia i latou i lo’u aasa, ma sa Ou soli i luga o i latou i lo’u ita, ma ua Ou sausau o’u ofu i lo latou toto, ma faapisipisia o’u ofu uma; ona o le aso lea o le tauimasui sa i ai i lo’u loto.

verses.en: And now the year of my redeemed is come; and they shall mention the loving kindness of their Lord, and all that he has bestowed upon them according to his goodness, and according to his loving kindness, forever and ever.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei ua oo mai le tausaga o a’u togiolaina; ma o le a latou ta’uta’ua le alofa agalelei o lo latou Alii, ma mea uma ua ia faaeeina i o latou luga e tusa ma lona lelei, ma e tusa ma lona alofa agalelei, e faavavau ma faavavau lava.

verses.en: In all their afflictions he was afflicted. And the angel of his presence saved them; and in his love, and in his pity, he redeemed them, and bore them, and carried them all the days of old;
verses.sm: Sa puapuaga o ia i o latou puapuagatia uma. Ma o le agelu mai ona luma na laveaiina i latou; ma o lona alofa, ma o lona loto mafatia, na ia togiolaina ai i latou, ma amo ai i latou, ma tauave ai i latou i aso uma anamua;

verses.en: Yea, and Enoch also, and they who were with him; the prophets who were before him; and Noah also, and they who were before him; and Moses also, and they who were before him;
verses.sm: Ioe, ma Enoka foi, ma i latou o e na faatasi ma ia; o perofeta o e na muamua ia te ia; ma Noa foi, ma i latou o e na muamua ia te ia; ma Mose foi, ma i latou o e na muamua ia te ia;

verses.en: And from Moses to Elijah, and from Elijah to John, who were with Christ in his resurrection, and the holy apostles, with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, shall be in the presence of the Lamb.
verses.sm: Ma e mai ia Mose ia Elia, ma mai ia Elia ia Ioane, o e na faatasi ma Keriso i lona toetu mai, ma le au aposetolo paia, faatasi ma Aperaamo, Isaako ma Iakopo, o le a i ai i luma o le Tamai Mamoe.

verses.en: And the graves of the saints shall be opened; and they shall come forth and stand on the right hand of the Lamb, when he shall stand upon Mount Zion, and upon the holy city, the New Jerusalem; and they shall sing the song of the Lamb, day and night forever and ever.
verses.sm: Ma o le a tatalaina tuugamau o le au paia; ma o le a latou o mai ma tutulai i le itu taumatau o le Tamai Mamoe, pe a tulai o ia i luga o le Mauga o Siona, ma i luga o le aai paia, o le Ierusalema Fou; ma o le a latou lagi le viiga o le Tamai Mamoe, i le ao ma le po e faavavau ma faavavau lava.

verses.en: And for this cause, that men might be made partakers of the glories which were to be revealed, the Lord sent forth the fulness of his gospel, his everlasting covenant, reasoning in plainness and simplicity—
verses.sm: Ma o le pogai lenei, ina ia mafai ona maua e tagata mamalu sa faamoemoe e faaali mai, na auina mai ai e le Alii le atoatoaga o lana talalelei, lana feagaiga tumau e faavavau, ua talatala atu i le manino ma le faigofie—

verses.en: To prepare the weak for those things which are coming on the earth, and for the Lord's errand in the day when the weak shall confound the wise, and the little one become a strong nation, and two shall put their tens of thousands to flight.
verses.sm: E saunia ai e ua vaivai mo mea na o le a oo mai i le lalolagi, ma mo le feau a le Alii i le aso pe a faafememeaiina e e vaivai le au popoto, ma avea ai lē ua laitiiti ma atunuu malosi, ma faia ai e le toalua a laua sefulu o afe o fili ia sosola ese.

verses.en: And by the weak things of the earth the Lord shall thresh the nations by the power of his Spirit.
verses.sm: Ma i mea vaivai o le lalolagi o le a vaevaeesea ai e le Alii atunuu i le mana o lona Agaga.

verses.en: And for this cause these commandments were given; they were commanded to be kept from the world in the day that they were given, but now are to go forth unto all flesh—
verses.sm: Ma o le pogai lenei na tuu atu ai nei poloaiga; sa poloa’ia ia taofia i latou mai le lalolagi i le aso na tuu atu ai i latou, ae o lenei ia tuuina atu nei i tagata uma—

verses.en: And this according to the mind and will of the Lord, who ruleth over all flesh.
verses.sm: Ma ua tusa lenei ma le mafaufau ma le finagalo o le Alii, o lē ua pule i tagata uma.

verses.en: And unto him that repenteth and sanctifieth himself before the Lord shall be given eternal life.
verses.sm: Ma o ia o lē e salamo ma faapaiaina o ia lava i luma o le Alii o le a tuuina atu i ai le ola e faavavau.

verses.en: And upon them that hearken not to the voice of the Lord shall be fulfilled that which was written by the prophet Moses, that they should be cut off from among the people.
verses.sm: Ma o i latou o e e lē faalogo i le siufofoga o le Alii, o le a faataunuuina i luga o i latou le mea na tusia e le perofeta o Mose, e tatau ona vavae ese i latou mai le nuu.

verses.en: And also that which was written by the prophet Malachi: For, behold, the day cometh that shall burn as an oven, and all the proud, yea, and all that do wickedly, shall be stubble; and the day that cometh shall burn them up, saith the Lord of hosts, that it shall leave them neither root nor branch.
verses.sm: Ma le mea foi na tusia e le perofeta o Malaki: Aua, faauta, e oo mai le aso o le a mu ai e pei o se ogaumu, ma o e uma ua faamaualuluga, ioe, ma e uma ua faia amioleaga, o le a avea ma tagutugutu o saito; ma o le a oo mai le aso o le a susunuina i latou, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii o ’au, o le a lē tuua ai mo i latou se a’a po o se lala.

verses.en: Wherefore, this shall be the answer of the Lord unto them:
verses.sm: O le mea lea, o le a avea lenei ma tali a le Alii ia te i latou:

verses.en: In that day when I came unto mine own, no man among you received me, and you were driven out.
verses.sm: I lena aso na Ou alu atu ai i o’u lava, sa leai se tagata sa i totonu o outou sa taliaina a’u, ma sa tulia outou i fafo.

verses.en: When I called again there was none of you to answer; yet my arm was not shortened at all that I could not redeem, neither my power to deliver.
verses.sm: Ina ua Ou toe valaau atu sa leai se isi o outou e tali mai; e ui i lea sa lei faapuupuuina lava lo’u lima sa lē mafai ai ona Ou togiola atu, po o lo’u mana e laveai ai.

verses.en: Behold, at my rebuke I dry up the sea. I make the rivers a wilderness; their fish stink, and die for thirst.
verses.sm: Faauta, o la’u aoaiga Ou te faapa’umātu ai le sami. Ou te faia vaitafe ia avea ma vaomatua; e manogi o latou i’a, ma mamate i le fia inu.

verses.en: I clothe the heavens with blackness, and make sackcloth their covering.
verses.sm: Ou te faaofuina le lagi i le pouliuli, ma faia ie talatala mo o latou ufiufi.

verses.en: And this shall ye have of my hand—ye shall lie down in sorrow.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei mea o le a outou maua mai i lo’u lima— o le a outou taooto i lalo i le faanoanoa.

verses.en: Behold, and lo, there are none to deliver you; for ye obeyed not my voice when I called to you out of the heavens; ye believed not my servants, and when they were sent unto you ye received them not.
verses.sm: Faauta, ma taga’i, ua leai se tasi e laveaiina outou; aua sa outou lē usiusitai i lo’u leo ina ua Ou valaau atu ia te outou mai le lagi; sa outou lē talitonu i a’u auauna, ma ina ua auina atu i latou ia te outou sa outou lē taliaina i latou.

verses.en: Wherefore, they sealed up the testimony and bound up the law, and ye were delivered over unto darkness.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, ua latou faamaufaailogaina ai le molimau ma fusifusia ai le tulafono, ma sa tuuina atu outou i le pouliuli.

verses.en: These shall go away into outer darkness, where there is weeping, and wailing, and gnashing of teeth.
verses.sm: O i latou nei o le a o ese atu i le pouliuli i fafo, i le mea o i ai le tagitu’i, ma le tagiauē, ma le lilivau o nifo.

verses.en: Behold the Lord your God hath spoken it. Amen.
verses.sm: Faauta o le Alii lo outou Atua ua fetalai mai ai. Amene.
